UnitStatement: AttachmentResolver defines MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES as 10 MiB per-file limit and MAX_TOTAL_ATTACHMENT_BYTES as 18 MiB total-per-turn budget for attachments.
MIME_BY_EXTENSION maps allowed attachment extensions (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .gif, .webp, .pdf, .txt, .md, .csv) to MIME types; ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS is the set of its keys.
AttachmentResolver implements IAttachmentResolver and exposes async resolveAttachmentsToContentBlocks(message, attachmentPaths) returning ResolvedAttachments with contentBlocks and errors.
resolveAttachmentsToContentBlocks prepends a text content block containing the message when the trimmed message is non-empty.
Attachment paths that are not absolute are rejected with reason 'Attachment path must be absolute'.
Attachments whose lowercased extension is not in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS are rejected as an unsupported extension, listing the allowed extensions.
Each attachment must pass an access(R_OK) readability check; ENOENT yields 'not found', EACCES/EPERM yields 'not readable'.
Attachments that are symbolic links (detected via lstat) are rejected; symbolic links are not accepted as attachments.
Attachments must reference a regular file; non-file stat results are rejected.
An attachment exceeding MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES (per-file limit) is rejected with a per-file size-limit error.
An attachment that would push totalAcceptedBytes past MAX_TOTAL_ATTACHMENT_BYTES is rejected with a per-turn size-budget error.
Accepted attachments append a content block of type 'file' with the path and resolved mimeType (defaulting to application/octet-stream).
StubAttachmentResolver extends AttachmentResolver with no behavior changes, used as a test/stub variant.
CHAT_DRAFT_STORAGE_PREFIX is the localStorage key prefix 'chirality.chatDraft.v1' for persisted chat drafts.
chat-draft defines storage warning constants for unavailable storage (in-memory only this session) and corrupt data (reset).
ChatDraftSnapshot type contains a draft string and an array of UiAttachment attachments.
buildChatDraftStorageKey(projectRoot, persona, mode) composes the storage key as PREFIX:projectRoot:persona:mode.
emptyChatDraftSnapshot returns a snapshot with empty draft string and empty attachments array.
sanitizeChatDraftSnapshot coerces unknown input into a ChatDraftSnapshot, reading the draft string and sanitizing stored attachments; non-objects yield the empty snapshot.
readChatDraftSnapshotFromStorage returns the empty snapshot with writable=false and unavailable-warning when storage.getItem throws.
readChatDraftSnapshotFromStorage returns the empty snapshot writable=true with no warning when no raw value is stored.

On JSON parse failure, readChatDraftSnapshotFromStorage removes the corrupt key and returns the empty snapshot with the corrupt-data warning; if removal also throws, returns writable=false unavailable-warning.
persistChatDraftSnapshotToStorage removes the key when the snapshot is empty, otherwise writes JSON; storage failures return writable=false with the unavailable warning.
A ChatDraftSnapshot is considered empty when both draft length and attachments length are zero.
chirality-hooks defines WRITE_HOOK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=5, SHELL_HOOK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=5, and HASH_INLINE_LIMIT_BYTES=1 MiB.
ChiralityToolHookInput carries sessionId, projectRoot, optional instructionRoot, and an optional resolveDescriptor function.
A hook descriptor is governed when it has 'workspace-write' or 'shell' permission; getHookFamily classifies it as 'shell' or 'write'.

summarizeFileState lstat-inspects a path, classifying symbolic-link/directory/other; for regular files it records byteLength and, when under HASH_INLINE_LIMIT_BYTES, a sha256 hash, otherwise omits the hash with reason 'file-too-large'.
summarizeFileState returns exists=false on ENOENT and exists=false with an error message on other failures.

allowPreToolUse returns a PreToolUse HookJSONOutput with continue=true, permissionDecision 'allow', and optional updatedInput; blockPreToolUse returns continue=false, decision 'block', permissionDecision 'deny' with reason.
createChiralityToolHooks returns hook callbacks keyed by HookEvent, maintaining a per-tool_use_id attempts Map and defaulting resolveDescriptor to getHarnessToolDescriptor.
The PreToolUse hook short-circuits (continue) for non-governed descriptors; only shell/write-governed tools are evaluated.

For shell-governed tools, PreToolUse evaluates evaluateShellCommandPolicy and blocks when not allowed, otherwise records policy metadata and allows with updatedInput, emitting DEFAULT_BASH_TIMEOUT_MS and resultBudget metadata.
For write-governed tools, PreToolUse evaluates evaluateToolPathPolicy, blocks when not allowed, otherwise records pathMetadata and a captured beforeState file summary then allows.
The PreToolUse write hook fails closed: any thrown error is logged as hook.failed and the tool is blocked with a 'failed closed' reason.

The PostToolUse hook records after-state file summary (for write tools), summarizes the tool result, persists shell result artifacts for shell tools, emits hook.completed with durationMs/resultMetadata, and deletes the attempt record.
The PostToolUseFailure hook emits hook.failed with policy/path metadata, durationMs, error, and interrupted flag, then deletes the attempt record.
createChiralityToolHooks registers PreToolUse, PostToolUse, and PostToolUseFailure matchers each with timeout = max(WRITE_HOOK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, SHELL_HOOK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS).
ClaudeAgentSdkManager pins SDK_PACKAGE_VERSION to '0.3.150'.
ClaudeAgentSdkManager implements IAgentSdkManager and AgentEnginePort with subject 'claude-agent-sdk' and tracks activeTurns by sessionId.
ClaudeAgentSdkManager constructor accepts an injectable sdkQuery (defaulting to the SDK query) and a buildSystemPrompt(projectRoot, persona, mode) function defaulting to returning empty string.

interrupt(sessionId) throws HarnessError SESSION_NOT_FOUND (404) when no active turn exists; otherwise it appends interruption.requested, sets interrupted, aborts the controller, and calls query.interrupt()/close().
startTurn is overloaded to accept either an AgentEngineRunInput or (session, message, opts, contentBlocks) and yields an AsyncIterable<UIEvent>.
When the input message trimmed equals 'bootstrap', startTurn yields a session:init event (engineSessionId/claudeSessionId/model) and a process:exit exitCode 0, then returns without running the SDK.
The bootstrap session id is derived from sdkSessionId ?? claudeSessionId ?? a generated `sdk_<uuid>`.
startTurn builds the system prompt, sdkOptions via buildSdkOptions, and sdkPrompt via buildSdkPrompt, then appends turn.accepted with provider and sdkPackageVersion before querying.
startTurn iterates the SDK stream; if interrupted mid-stream it appends interruption.completed and turn.cancelled, yields process:exit exitCode 130 interrupted=true, and returns.
Each SDK message is mapped via mapSdkMessageToHarness; harness events are appended and UI events yielded, tracking whether a terminal process:exit was seen.
If no terminal process:exit was emitted by the stream, startTurn yields a process:exit exitCode 0.
On error, if interrupted/aborted startTurn emits interruption.completed/turn.cancelled and process:exit 130; otherwise it appends turn.failed and throws HarnessError SDK_FAILURE (500).
startTurn always deletes the session from activeTurns in a finally block.
HarnessTurnStreamEvent is { event: string; data: unknown } representing a parsed SSE stream frame.
HarnessApiClientError extends Error with readonly status, code, and optional details, name 'HarnessApiClientError'.
readJson<T> attempts response.json() and returns undefined on parse failure.
fromHarnessErrorPayload builds a HarnessApiClientError from a payload, defaulting code to 'HARNESS_API_ERROR' and using payload error message/details.
requestHarnessJson fetches, throws fromHarnessErrorPayload on non-ok, throws INVALID_RESPONSE on empty body, otherwise returns the parsed payload.
parseSseFrame splits a frame into lines, reads the 'event:' name and concatenated 'data:' lines, returns null without event or data, and JSON-parses data (falling back to raw string).
openTurnStream POSTs to /api/harness/turn with JSON body, returns the response when ok, otherwise throws fromHarnessErrorPayload with 'Unable to start harness turn'.
harnessApiErrorMessage formats HarnessApiClientError as 'code: message', plain Errors as their message, else a generic failure string.
createHarnessSession POSTs to /api/harness/session/create and returns the session record.
bootHarnessSession POSTs to /api/harness/session/boot returning a SessionBootResponse.
interruptHarnessSession POSTs to /api/harness/interrupt to interrupt a session.
scaffoldHarnessExecutionRoot POSTs to /api/harness/scaffold with executionRoot, decompositionPath, optional projectName and coordinationMode, returning a ScaffoldExecutionRootResponse.

streamHarnessTurn opens a turn stream, reads the response body via a reader, decodes chunks, splits on '\n\n' frame boundaries, and invokes onEvent for each parsed SSE frame including a trailing frame.
streamHarnessTurn throws INVALID_RESPONSE when the turn response has no stream body.

EngineConformanceIssueCode enumerates STREAM_THREW, UNKNOWN_UI_EVENT, MISSING_SESSION_INIT, MISSING_ENGINE_SESSION_ID, MISSING_SESSION_INIT_MODEL, MISSING_PROCESS_EXIT, PROCESS_EXIT_NOT_TERMINAL, MISSING_INTERRUPTED_PROCESS_EXIT.
EngineConformanceOptions toggles requireSessionInit, requireEngineSessionId, and requireInterruptedProcessExit checks.
EngineConformanceReport contains subject, passed flag, events, eventTypes, and issues list.
evaluateEventStream records a STREAM_THREW issue when a thrownError is present.
evaluateEventStream flags any event whose type is not in the PUBLIC_UI_EVENT_NAMES set as UNKNOWN_UI_EVENT.
evaluateEventStream flags MISSING_SESSION_INIT when requireSessionInit is not false and no session:init event was emitted.
For each session:init event, evaluateEventStream flags MISSING_ENGINE_SESSION_ID (when required and absent) and MISSING_SESSION_INIT_MODEL when model metadata is absent.
evaluateEventStream flags MISSING_PROCESS_EXIT when no process:exit event exists, and PROCESS_EXIT_NOT_TERMINAL when process:exit is not the final event.
When requireInterruptedProcessExit is set, evaluateEventStream flags MISSING_INTERRUPTED_PROCESS_EXIT unless some process:exit has exitCode 130 and interrupted=true.
A conformance report passes only when its issues list is empty.
runEngineConformance collects all events from port.startTurn(input), captures any thrown error, and returns evaluateEventStream over them.
runEngineInterruptConformance advances the stream once, calls port.interrupt(sessionId), drains the rest, and evaluates with requireInterruptedProcessExit=true.
ERROR_COPY maps HarnessErrorType values to user-facing title/message/nextStep copy for the UI.
The ATTACHMENT_FAILURE error copy is titled 'Attachment Validation Failed' advising the user to attach readable files or include non-empty text.
The MISSING_API_KEY error copy advises setting ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and retrying the turn.
MAX_ATTACHMENT_ERROR_DETAILS limits the inline attachment-error preview to 2 entries.
parseAttachmentError validates an object with string path and reason, returning an AttachmentError or null.
parseAttachmentFailureDetails extracts a non-empty attachmentErrors array and a rejectedAttachmentCount (falling back to the parsed error count).
basenameLike returns the last path segment after splitting on slashes/backslashes, used to shorten paths in error previews.
withAttachmentFailureDetails appends a 'Rejections:' preview of up to MAX_ATTACHMENT_ERROR_DETAILS basename:reason entries plus a '(+N more)' suffix.

toHarnessUiError maps a HarnessApiClientError to its ERROR_COPY (adding attachment-failure details for ATTACHMENT_FAILURE), falls back to a generic 'Harness Request Failed', and handles non-API errors as 'Unexpected Harness Failure'.
HarnessError extends Error with readonly type (HarnessErrorType), status number, optional details, and name 'HarnessError'.

isHarnessErrorType recognizes the closed set of harness error types: INVALID_REQUEST, TURN_IN_PROGRESS, MISSING_API_KEY, PERSONA_NOT_FOUND, INSTRUCTION_ROOT_INVALID, SDK_FAILURE, SESSION_NOT_FOUND, WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE, WORKING_ROOT_CONFLICT, ATTACHMENT_FAILURE.
isHarnessErrorLike type-guards an object with a valid harness type, finite numeric status, and string message.

asHarnessError returns the error unchanged if a HarnessError, reconstructs one from a harness-error-like object, wraps a plain Error as SDK_FAILURE 500, and otherwise returns a generic SDK_FAILURE 500.

HARNESS_EVENT_TYPES is the canonical const tuple of harness event type names (session/turn/message/model/tool/hook/queue/branch/interruption/context.compaction/subagent/runtime.mirror lifecycle events).
HarnessEventType is the union of HARNESS_EVENT_TYPES values.
HarnessEvent carries schemaVersion 1, eventId, sessionId, optional turnId/parentEventId, ISO timestamp, type, and a data record.
createHarnessEvent builds a HarnessEvent with schemaVersion 1, a generated `evt_<uuid>` eventId, current ISO timestamp, and defaulting data to an empty object.
readJsonBody parses a Request JSON body and throws HarnessError INVALID_REQUEST (400) 'Request body must be valid JSON' on failure.
requireNonEmptyString throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) for non-string or blank values and returns the trimmed string otherwise.
requireStringArray throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) unless the value is an array of strings.
errorResponse converts any error via asHarnessError and returns a NextResponse JSON error body (type/message/details) with the harness error status.

formatSseEvent formats an SSE frame as 'event: <event>
data: <json>

'.
REQUIRED_FILE_ENTRIES for an instruction root: AGENTS.md, README.md, and docs/{DIRECTIVE,CONTRACT,SPEC,TYPES,PLAN}.md.
REQUIRED_DIRECTORY_ENTRIES for an instruction root are 'agents' and 'docs'.
resolveInstructionRootFromEnv returns the resolved CHIRALITY_INSTRUCTION_ROOT env path if set, else undefined.
resolveInstructionRootFromWorkspace probes cwd/.. and cwd/../../.. candidates, returning the first containing all required entries, else the first candidate.
resolveInstructionRootPath prefers the env override, otherwise resolves from the workspace.
instructionRootContainsPath returns true when targetPath resolves at or inside the instruction root (relative not starting with '..' and not absolute).

assertInstructionRootReadable verifies each required directory is a readable/executable directory and each required file is a readable file, throwing INSTRUCTION_ROOT_INVALID (500) with missing/invalid entries listed.
ChiralityReadMcpContext carries projectRoot and sessionId for read-only MCP tool execution.

Read MCP tool arg types: StatusReadArgs/DependenciesReadArgs take a deliverablePath; ScopeScanArgs is empty; ScaffoldPreviewArgs takes executionRoot, decompositionPath, optional projectName and coordinationMode.
jsonToolResult wraps a value as a CallToolResult with a single text content block containing pretty-printed JSON.
runReadMcpToolWithEvidence emits tool.started before execution and tool.completed (with durationMs and result metadata) on success, re-throwing after a best-effort tool.failed event.
assertLexicallyWithinProjectRoot throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) when a candidate path resolves outside projectRoot (lexical check, no realpath).
assertExistingPathWithinProjectRoot realpath-resolves both project root and candidate and throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) when the candidate is outside the project root.
statusReadTool reads parsed deliverable status via readDeliverableStatus under the status_read evidence wrapper.
dependenciesReadTool reads parsed deliverable dependencies via readDeliverableDependencies under the deps_read evidence wrapper.
scopeScanTool normalizes the project root and returns projectRoot, scannedAt timestamp, and scanProjectScopes results under the scope_scan wrapper.
scaffoldPreviewTool validates executionRoot lexically and decompositionPath via realpath within project root, then returns previewScaffoldExecutionRoot output.
createChiralityReadMcpServer builds an SDK MCP server named CHIRALITY_MCP_SERVER_NAME version 1.0.0 registering status_read, deps_read, scope_scan, and scaffold_preview tools with zod-validated args.
The Chirality read MCP server instructions state its tools are read-only and do not write files, run shell commands, or access networks.
createChiralityReadMcpServers returns an empty record unless at least one allowed tool name is a Chirality MCP tool, otherwise registers the read MCP server under the server name.
filterChiralityMcpAllowedToolNames filters a list down to Chirality MCP allowed tool names.
CHIRALITY_MCP_SERVER_NAME is 'chirality'.
CHIRALITY_MCP_READ_TOOL_NAMES are status_read, deps_read, scope_scan, scaffold_preview.
ChiralityMcpAllowedToolName has the form mcp__chirality__<readToolName>; CHIRALITY_MCP_ALLOWED_TOOL_NAMES derives the prefixed names.
toChiralityMcpAllowedToolName prefixes a read tool name with mcp__chirality__; isChiralityMcpAllowedToolName type-guards membership in the allowed-name set.
Harness option defaults: DEFAULT_MODEL='claude-sonnet-4-20250514', DEFAULT_TOOLS=['read','write','bash'], DEFAULT_MAX_TURNS=12.
GLOBAL_MODEL_ENV_VAR is 'CHIRALITY_GLOBAL_MODEL'; SUPPORTED_OPT_KEYS are model, tools, maxTurns, persona, mode, subagentGovernance.
asPositiveInteger returns the value only when it is a positive integer, else undefined.
readPersonaDefaults reads the persona agent instruction frontmatter and extracts tools (string array) and maxTurns (positive integer).
readGlobalModelFromInstructionRoot prefers CHIRALITY_GLOBAL_MODEL env, otherwise reads the model from the instruction root AGENTS.md frontmatter, returning undefined on failure.
warnOnUnknownOpts logs a sorted warning for opts fields not in SUPPORTED_OPT_KEYS.

resolveRuntimeOptions resolves persona/mode (opts then session), loads persona defaults and global model in parallel, and produces ResolvedOpts with model/tools/maxTurns precedence opts > persona/global > defaults.
HARNESS_PERMISSION_POLICY_VERSION is 'harness-permission.v3.bash'.
Harness permission decision values are 'allow' | 'deny' | 'ask'; decision sources include sdk-option, sdk-callback, chirality-policy, hook, human, prompt-support.
NormalizedHarnessPermissionMode is one of readOnly, workspaceWrite, dontAsk, ask, bypass.
normalizeHarnessPermissionMode maps known mode strings to their normalized value and defaults unknown modes to 'ask'.

createDecision builds a HarnessPermissionDecision with a generated perm_<uuid> id, defaulted sessionId, chirality-policy default source, ISO decidedAt, and safeMetadata embedding policy version, mode, and descriptor summary fields.
resolveHarnessPermissionDecision denies (hardDeny) when explicitDeny is set, when the descriptor is unknown, or when the descriptor surface is 'reserved'.
For shell-permission tools, resolveHarnessPermissionDecision allows in workspaceWrite mode (requiresHookApproval), asks in ask mode, and denies in other modes.
Tools with 'danger' permission are hard-denied; tools with 'network' permission are hard-denied pending a future governed tranche.
Tools with 'subagent' permission are hard-denied pending governed SDK agent definitions and fail-closed hooks.
For workspace-write tools, resolveHarnessPermissionDecision allows in workspaceWrite mode (requiresHookApproval), asks in ask mode, and denies in other modes.
Tools with 'read' permission are allowed in the current mode; tools with no supported permission class are denied as 'unsupported-permission'.
permissionDecisionToSdkResult maps an allow decision to behavior 'allow', and ask/deny to behavior 'deny' (ask adds an application-approval-required message).
appendPermissionDecisionEvent emits a tool.permission harness event carrying behavior, decisionId, reason, source, toolName, mode, descriptor summary, and safeMetadata.

createHarnessCanUseTool returns a CanUseTool callback that evaluates path policy (and shell policy for shell tools), builds a permission decision (denying on policy failure), appends the decision event, and denies on audit-append failure.
StubPersonaManager implements IPersonaManager: buildSystemPrompt ensures the persona exists then returns 'Persona=<persona>; mode=<mode>; projectRoot=<root>'.
StubPersonaManager.getBootFingerprint returns the first 32 hex chars of sha256('<persona>::<mode>').
escapeRegExp escapes regex metacharacters in a string for safe use in a RegExp.
toLowercasePercentEncoding lowercases percent-encoded sequences (%XX) in a string.
addEncodedKeyVariantCandidates adds an encoded key and its lowercased form to the variant set, plus query-style '+' variants when %20 is present.
addUrlEncodedKeyVariants iterates two rounds of URL-encoding to accumulate API-key encoding variants for redaction matching.
readConfiguredApiKeyVariants collects configured keys (UI key, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, CHIRALITY_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), expands URL-encoded variants, and returns them sorted by descending length.
redactConfiguredApiKeys replaces all occurrences of any configured API-key variant in a message with '[REDACTED_API_KEY]'.
redactJsonLike recursively redacts API keys from strings, arrays, and object values while preserving structure.
HarnessRuntime aggregates sessionManager, personaManager, attachmentResolver, agentSdkManager, and turnEngine.
The harness runtime is cached on globalThis under __CHIRALITY_HARNESS_RUNTIME__.
HarnessProviderMode is 'stub' | 'anthropic' | 'agentSdk'.
resolveHarnessProviderMode reads CHIRALITY_HARNESS_PROVIDER: agentsdk/agent-sdk/claude-agent-sdk -> agentSdk, anthropic -> anthropic, else stub.
buildAgentSdkManager returns AnthropicAgentSdkManager for anthropic, ClaudeAgentSdkManager (wired to the global persona manager's buildSystemPrompt) for agentSdk, else StubAgentSdkManager.
getHarnessRuntime lazily constructs and caches the runtime (FileSessionManager, StubPersonaManager, AttachmentResolver, provider-selected agent SDK manager, and a TurnEngine).
resetHarnessRuntimeForTests deletes the cached global runtime to reset state between tests.
sanitize defines ILLEGAL_LABEL_CHARACTERS regex matching / \ : * ? " < > | and CONSECUTIVE_WHITESPACE matching runs of whitespace.
sanitizeLabel (SPEC 10.1) replaces illegal filesystem characters with '-', collapses consecutive whitespace to one space, and trims.
sanitizeNonEmptyLabel sanitizes a label and throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) when the result is empty.
scaffold defines PKG_ID_PATTERN /^PKG-\d{2,3}$/ and DEL_ID_PATTERN /^DEL-\d{2,3}-\d{2}$/ for package and deliverable IDs.

EXECUTION_ROOT_DIRECTORIES enumerates the top-level execution-root folders (_Aggregation, _Change, _Coordination, _Decomposition, _Estimates, _Reconciliation, _Archive, _Scripts, _Sources and archive/template subdirs).
REQUIRED_PACKAGE_SUBDIRECTORIES define the per-package folder layout: 0_References, 1_Working, 2_Checking (From/To), 3_Issued and their _Archive subdirs.
PREPARATION_REQUIRED_METADATA_FILES are _STATUS.md, _CONTEXT.md, _DEPENDENCIES.md, _REFERENCES.md, _SEMANTIC.md.
COORDINATION_MODES are SCHEDULE_FIRST, DEPENDENCY_TRACKED, HYBRID; CoordinationMode is their union type.
LayoutValidationResult reports executionRoot validity plus per-package and per-deliverable validity with missing-path lists.
PreparationCompatibilityResult reports overall readiness, deliverablesChecked count, issueCount, and per-deliverable issue lists.
ScaffoldFailureStage enumerates the ordered scaffolding stages used for fail-fast error context (ensure_execution_root through validate_preparation_compatibility).
withScaffoldFailureContext wraps an error into a HarnessError carrying FAIL_FAST strategy, failing stage, targetPath, created directories/files, and guidance, preserving existing detail fields.
requireAbsolutePath throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) for missing/blank input or non-absolute paths and returns the resolved absolute path.
parseMarkdownTableRow parses a pipe-delimited markdown table row into trimmed cells, returning null for non-table or separator rows.
extractProjectName takes the first '# ' heading, strips the marker, splits on an em-dash/hyphen separator, and returns the leading segment (defaulting to 'Chirality Project').
parseDecomposition scans markdown for PKG headings/rows and DEL rows under the current package, deduplicating by ID, and returns sorted packages with their deliverables.
parseDecomposition throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) when no parseable packages or deliverables are found.
parseCoordinationMode defaults undefined to DEPENDENCY_TRACKED and throws INVALID_REQUEST (400) for non-string or unrecognized coordination modes.
buildPackagePlans maps each package to a sanitized '<id>_<label>' folder with its required subdirectories and per-deliverable paths under 1_Working as '<id>_<label>'.
getPlannedDirectories assembles the full planned directory list: execution root, execution-root subdirs, and each package's expected and deliverable paths.
ensureDirectory verifies an existing path is a directory (throwing WORKING_ROOT_INACCESSIBLE 409 if a file), and creates it recursively on ENOENT, tracking created directories.
ensureFile is a no-op if the file exists, otherwise writes UTF-8 content and tracks the created file; non-ENOENT access errors raise SDK_FAILURE 500.
findMissingPaths returns the subset of paths failing an F_OK access check; pathExists returns a boolean for a single path.

previewScaffoldExecutionRoot validates absolute paths, reads/parses the decomposition markdown, and returns planned directories, files (copied decomposition, INIT.md, _COORDINATION.md), and package plans without writing.
buildInitTemplate produces the INIT.md content with project name, ISO date, decomposition reference, coordination mode, and a Session Parameters section.
buildCoordinationTemplate produces _COORDINATION.md with the representation, FULL_GRAPH dependency tracking, the list of coordination representations, and selection notes.
validateLayout checks the execution root expected paths plus per-package and per-deliverable expected paths, returning validity and missing-path lists.
validatePreparationCompatibility checks each deliverable directory exists/is writable and that any present PREPARATION metadata files are writable non-directories, aggregating issues and readiness.

scaffoldExecutionRoot validates inputs, parses the decomposition, then sequentially ensures execution-root dirs, copies the decomposition, writes INIT.md and _COORDINATION.md, creates package/subdir/deliverable directories, and runs layout and preparation-compatibility validation.
scaffoldExecutionRoot copies the decomposition only when the copied path differs from the source path, skipping copy if the target already exists.
scaffoldExecutionRoot tracks failureStage/failurePath through each step and wraps any thrown error with withScaffoldFailureContext for fail-fast diagnostics.
The generated INIT.md template includes a 'Session Parameters' section instructing users to add project-specific startup constraints.
The generated _COORDINATION.md template lists coordination representations SCHEDULE_FIRST, DEPENDENCY_TRACKED, HYBRID.
The generated _COORDINATION.md selection notes state the full dependency graph remains audit truth while a blocker subset may serve as execution sequencing truth per project policy.
